newsitem.title: GERMANY: FORECAST-Spain's Rato sees Q3 GDP up 2.3-2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Spain's Rato sees Q3 GDP up 2.3-2.5 pct.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Friday he expected third quarter gross domestic product to have grown by 2.3 to 2.5 percent.
In an interview with Reuters Financial Television, Rato said: "We have a forecast for the full year of 2.3 percent, so in the third quarter we should have seen 2.3 to 2.5 percent."
In Frankfurt to attend a bankers congress, Rato said initial figures for October were showing a pickup in private consumption, construction and in industrial production.
"The Spanish econonomy is on a path of long-term non-inflationary growth and we think this will increase over the next months," Rato said.
Earlier Rato said he expects Spain's economy to grow by three percent next year, helped by stronger consumption and investment demand.
